picks.name: Zelooperz & Black Noi$e
picks.source_note: Black Noi$e already in your library. New label discovery -- Tan Cressida (Earl Sweatshirt's label), Zelooperz's debut there.
picks.bio: "Pin Breakers" (November 13, 2026, Tan Cressida, cat. TC015D) is an eleven-track album from Detroit rapper Zelooperz produced entirely by Black Noi$e, his first release on Earl Sweatshirt's label, featuring a guest verse from Danny Brown on "Nostradamus."
picks.why_listen: Warped, bass-heavy experimental hip hop production paired with Zelooperz's unpredictable flow -- good for a left-field, head-turning moment in a set.

picks.name: CASSIMM & WARED
picks.source_note: Nervous Records already seeded. New artist discovery.
picks.bio: "Move To The Music" (November 6, 2026, Nervous Records) is a house collaboration between London-based Italian producer CASSIMM -- known for releases on Toolroom, Defected and SNATCH! -- and WARED.
picks.why_listen: Clean, driving house built for the dancefloor -- a reliable groove-driver from a dependable house producer.
